name: program-runtime.research-workspace-review
purpose: Inspect guide, checkpoint and current-view presence and sizes for an explicitly authorized research root.

research_root.description: Absolute research root authorized by the caller; not a session identifier.

assumptions: Caller is authorized to read the named root; local runtime reads are not sandbox confinement.
invariants: A path resolving outside the root is not inspected; skipped entries produce partial coverage.
At most 512 topics and 5000 run entries are inspected; at most eight examples per category are returned.
Sizes and absent files are review signals, not findings of research quality.
One bounded JSON envelope is returned.

signals.largest: At most eight checkpoint size signals and current-view sizes.
signals.truncated: The topic or run bound was reached.
signals.skipped_outside_root: Paths resolving outside the selected root; coverage is partial.
